coverage.identity: Derby County identifies Eyez as a grime MC and host. None of the inspected sources establishes a former stage name.
coverage.place: The childhood paragraph in the RamsTV announcement establishes that Eyez grew up in Derby. Asylum Agency also describes Eyez as Derby-based.
coverage.biography: The RamsTV announcement gives his early JDZ Media freestyles and the club’s appointment of him as a host. The Zdot release establishes a later recording credit.
coverage.connections: Don’t Flop names Dialect as a clash opponent. The Square One track listing credits producers Zdot and Krunchie. These credits do not establish a shared crew.

search.finding: The track listing gives a release date for Square One. It does not give career boundaries.
Derby County describes the earlier freestyles. The article does not date the start of Eyez’s career.

evidence.value: Square One by Eyez was released on 24 October 2021.
evidence.locator: Square One artist heading and release date directly below the track list.

search.finding: The agency identifies the Derby MC by his RamsTV presenting credit and offers a named booking form. The page gives no availability dates.
